STRATEGY: Parent slot8 is a forgiving TFT-like strategy that starts C,C, detects all-C/all-D, punishes streak_d>=2, forgives single defections after long CC, and defects in the last 5 rounds when cooperation is high. The trace simulates it against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D probes. It considers changes to improve recovery from long defection runs, add Pavlov-style probing, exploit non-retaliators, and avoid endgame defection against TFT-like opponents.

The trace simulates the parent against TFT-like, always-C, always-D, periodic, and forgiving opponents, and proposes adding an early probe/exploit branch when the opponent has never defected, plus a mutual-defection recovery rule.
